**Finding submitted — ASSIGN: deviation (Section 10.3, ¶p0063).**

- **What's there:** Only a boilerplate "binding upon successors and assigns" sentence. No assignment mechanics: no affiliate/successor carve-out for us, no consent gate or reasonableness standard on HDI, and nothing stopping HDI from assigning to a Deerskin competitor. That fails even the fallback level.
- **Change-of-control:** I checked Section 4 (Term/Termination/Termination Payment) and the whole Article 10 run — no HDI termination or re-pricing right on our change of control, so we are not in walk-away territory, but the position is unconfirmed and is now stated expressly.
- **Redline (preferred level, validated ok:true):** one short inserted paragraph after 10.3 covering all six preferred elements, with the existing sentence preserved verbatim and no added boilerplate.
